raw_transcript: Um, the imaginary Pebble gateway finally stayed connected through our lab test. I instrumented the MQTT reconnect path in Rust while Dana Wren, the systems engineer, controlled the access point. We disconnected Wi-Fi 20 times. Nineteen reconnects finished within 2 seconds; one took 11 seconds. I nearly called it a hundred percent fast recovery, no, that is wrong. All 20 recovered eventually, but one was slow. The logs suggest a DNS timeout, although we need packet captures to confirm that. I reduced a retry sleep from 5 seconds to 1 second only in the test build. We have not checked power consumption. The next step is a battery test with the original antenna.
